description: carrier_plan@1 parameters (vocabulary, shares, templated share and ceiling) for the SSN pilot. Pass vocabulary and shares as JSON text; rows comes from sizes.json. Values follow BRD-MIDATAWORKS-BEHAVIOUR-DATA-001 section 6.3 and the D32 starting values; shares are proposals the operator may change (any change is recorded on the version as its configuration). Form names use '_' where the BRD writes 'digits:<delimiter style>'. framing_phrase_share is 0: insert_element@1 puts a phrase from phrase_list before the element whatever the row's framing, so a non-zero share writes 'SSN:' before numbers the label calls no disclosure (other_type, other_number, discussed_in_general, naming_no_value; review 2026-10-25). Raise it only once phrases can be limited to the positive framings. Kind shares (ENH-006 D89, 2026-10-30): pos is 0.32, not D32's 0.40, because recipe.json's slot_siblings step gives every pos carrier four code-made siblings (empty, lookalike, naming_no_value, masked), so pairs are pos x 5 of the rows over 1 + pos x 4: 0.40 gave 76.9% paired rows, 0.32 gives 70.2% (D89's 70%). The 0.08 went to the near-miss kinds siblings cannot make (wrong_length 0.08 -> 0.11, bad_check 0.10 -> 0.13, glued_letters 0.07 -> 0.09), because the siblings already add one lookalike, one naming_no_value and one masked row per pos carrier; the free-form share is where the other near misses come from.
